excluded_by_design.OMUX: collinear with IMUX at corr=0.99 -- architecturally inseparable; only their sum is measured, the split is not identifiable. Left at worst-case.
excluded_by_design.SeamMUX: collinear with TileClkMUX at corr=1.00. Left at worst-case.

provenance.ground_truth_validation: The 21 paths that are a pure single-OMUX + single-IMUX 2-hop chain measure 0.383-0.401 ns (median 0.401), matching the independently-pinned exact value of 0.401 ns in wire_timing_exact_safe.json / wire_timing_exact_safe_manifest.json exactly -- the one family pair with independent ground truth, and the fit reproduces it.
provenance.landed_by: AG32-Docs docs/TASK_QUEUE.md Queue J task J2
provenance.method: NNLS fit of sum(family_delay_ns * hop_count) = measured_increment against the closed reference backend's static timing analysis (setup.rpt), joined per-hop to route.tx via packed.vx pin->net lookup and disambiguated by destination-tile / resource-z match. See AG32-Docs tools/wire_timing_fit/{attribute.py,fit.py} for the full join and NNLS procedure.
provenance.scope_caveat: ONE design, ONE part, ONE PVT corner. This is EVIDENCE, not a characterisation -- it must not be read as bounding every routing situation on this family, only as a measured point that is less pessimistic than the worst-case table for this design.
provenance.source_design: AG32-Docs tools/wide_boundary_witness (witness_macro, reference build scored 119.474 MHz)
